verdict.rationale: Ollama is an LLM inference runtime and server, so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair serving-performance question for it. The evidence pack never mentions separating prefill and decode phases, disaggregated serving, or any large-scale distributed inference architecture. Claims about dedicated cloud capacity and running multiple models concurrently are adjacent throughput features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
